summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Chutex Care marketing website. All 19 tests passed successfully. Homepage loads correctly with all sections visible, navigation works, language switcher toggles between EN/FR, mobile responsive design works properly, and all product cards display correct pricing.

integration_issues.issue: CORS error when calling ipapi.co/json/ for language/currency auto-detection. Site falls back to browser language detection which works correctly.

action_items: Consider using a backend proxy for ipapi.co geolocation API to avoid CORS issues, or use a CORS-friendly geolocation service
critical_code_review_comments: All data-testid attributes are properly implemented for testing
i18n implementation is clean with proper translations for FR/EN
External CDN images load properly from Shopify and Emergent static storage
Mobile responsive design is well implemented with proper breakpoints
test_credentials: N/A - marketing site with no authentication
context_for_next_testing_agent: Chutex Care marketing website is fully functional. All homepage sections work: Hero, Store Logos, Products (Elder 879€, Elio 24.9€/month, Vita 229€), Stats (0.08s, 36h, 50m, 10+), App Section with App Store/Play Store links, Testimonials (3 items), CTA Section, and Footer. Language switcher toggles between EN/FR correctly. Mobile responsive design works with hamburger menu. Only minor issue is CORS error with ipapi.co geolocation API which doesn't affect functionality.
